name: Caledonian Sleeper
niche_feature: Overnight sleeper train between London and Scotland; guests sleep in private rooms (Club En-suite twin-bunk rooms, Double En-suite, Classic) on the train. Seated coaches also exist but are not sleeping rooms.
evidence_quote: Our private Club En-suite rooms feature twin bunk beds with a handcrafted Glencraft mattress and an en-suite shower room.
reason: Operating overnight sleeper train with private sleeping rooms; guests sleep on the train.
page_issues: Club room described with a fold-down double bed; official Club En-suite room has twin bunk beds (double beds are a separate Double room type)
Panoramic windows, complimentary morning newspaper and lounge-only Wi-Fi not supported (official lists in-room Wi-Fi)
Superlative 'most efficient night's accommodation in Britain'
'Six routes' not confirmed on the official pages checked

name: Northern Rail Traincar Inn
niche_feature: All 15 guest rooms are in real renovated train boxcars (Porter rooms and Conductor suites) linked by an enclosed hallway; themed rooms. Depot-style main building is the breakfast/guest area.
evidence_quote: Northern Rail features 15 rooms in real train boxcars that have been renovated with modern day amenities.
reason: Every bookable room is a stationary converted boxcar; closes each April per official About page.

name: Rocky Mountaineer
niche_feature: Daylight-only scenic rail journey; no sleeping on the train. Guests stay overnight in hotels (e.g. Kamloops) between travel days. Official site blocked (HTTP 403); confirmed via Seat61 and Wikipedia.
evidence_quote: the journey takes 2 full days with an overnight hotel stop in Kamloops included in the fare.
reason: Guests do not sleep on the train; it is a daytime scenic rail tour with hotel nights, so not a train hotel.
page_issues: Page itself says daytime-only and hotel stays required, i.e. no sleeping on the train, which contradicts the train-hotels category
Wikipedia: sleeper services are not offered (that sentence is flagged citation-needed there; Seat61 confirms hotel stop)

name: Rovos Rail
niche_feature: Private luxury train based in Pretoria; guests sleep in private en-suite compartments (Pullman, Deluxe, Royal Suite) on multi-night journeys across southern Africa. Official site blocked (HTTP 403); Wikipedia used.
evidence_quote: Rovos Rail runs its train-hotel to a regular schedule on various routes throughout Southern Africa, from South Africa to Namibia and Tanzania.
reason: Overnight multi-day sleeper train with en-suite sleeping compartments; category confirmed.
page_issues: 'Cape to Cairo' two-week journey not supported; Wikipedia lists Cape Town to Dar es Salaam (15 nights)
'World's most luxurious train' and 'surpass most five star hotels' are unsupported superlatives
Royal Suite 'windows on three sides' and 'Union Limited' provenance not confirmed by the source

name: The Ghan
niche_feature: Journey Beyond Rail's Adelaide-Darwin train; guests sleep in private cabins (Gold, Gold Premium, Platinum, Aurora/Australis suites) on 2-3 night journeys (3-4 days).
evidence_quote: Onboard you will find sumptuous dining, elegant private cabins, attentive service, and the camaraderie of your fellow travellers.
reason: Operating multi-night sleeper train with private cabins; category correct.
page_issues: Service classes listed are incomplete: official site also has Gold Premium (private en suite) and Aurora/Australis Suites
Gold 'shares bathroom facilities' not supported by the official Gold description
'54 hours' fixed duration: official lists 3-4 days / 2-3 nights, with a new four-day itinerary from 2027

name: The Old Railway Station
niche_feature: Eight rooms (2 King Pullman, 6 Standard Pullman) are in restored Pullman carriages; two rooms (Station House Lower/Upper) and a self-catering Station Masters Suite are in the old station building.
evidence_quote: Stay in a Pullman Carriage at The Old Railway Station in Petworth, or in the old Station building itself.
reason: Guests sleep in stationary restored Pullman carriages at a former station; only some rooms are carriages.

name: Train Station Inn
niche_feature: Guest accommodation is vintage Canadian-built cabooses and boxcars converted to private suites beside the original c.1887 station building. Seasonal booking (May 1 to Oct 11 in 2026).
evidence_quote: Our unique accommodations are vintage Canadian-built cabooses & boxcars, authentic on the outside, redesigned and developed into private deluxe suites on the inside
reason: All bookable suites are converted railway cars on the station grounds; seasonal.

name: Vagony na horách
niche_feature: Four retired railway wagons (Alois, Fanynka, Lesní, Přednostův) on the unused fourth track at Kovářská station, fitted as insulated studios. A fifth stay, Vechtrovna, is a former trackman's house, not a wagon.
evidence_quote: Odstavili jsme je na nepoužívané 4. koleji nádraží Kovářská v Krušných horách.
reason: Guests sleep in converted stationary railway wagons at Kovářská station; one of five stays is a building.

name: Venice Simplon-Orient-Express
niche_feature: Belmond's sleeper train with restored 1920s carriages: Grand Suites, L'Observatoire suite, Suites (4 per carriage) and Historic Cabins (8 per carriage, shared restrooms), on routes to over 15 European cities.
reason: Operating overnight sleeper train with private cabins and suites; category correct.
page_issues: 'Private en-suite cabin suites': only Suites have en-suite bathrooms; Historic Cabins use shared restrooms at carriage end
'London to Venice' is not among the official signature journeys listed (Paris to Venice, Istanbul to Paris, etc.)
'Most famous train in the world' and 'irreplaceable' are unsupported superlatives

name: Wolkensteiner Zughotel
niche_feature: Guests sleep in original sleeping-car compartments (10 compartments, 1st/2nd class, government compartment, two suites) and five 'Ferienzug' holiday-apartment wagons; two holiday apartments are in the 1865 station building (ordinary rooms). 54 sleeping places in total.
evidence_quote: man übernachtet in Eisenbahnwagen bzw. Abteilen, rustikal und nostalgisch
reason: Most accommodation is in stationary converted railway carriages; station-building apartments are ordinary.

name: ZUGHOTEL Waldkirchen
niche_feature: Two former ÖBB construction-train wagons at the station, converted to sleeping wagons (4 single rooms; 1 double and 2 single rooms), sleeping 8 guests in total. Seasonal; 2026 season ended 21 September.
evidence_quote: Das Hotel besteht aus mehreren ehemaligen Bauzug-Waggons der ÖBB.
reason: All guest rooms are in stationary converted railway wagons; seasonal operation.

name: Bambu Indah
niche_feature: One Treehouse (sleeps 3) among 24 houses: a separate bamboo structure set in the branches of two bunut trees. The other houses (joglo bridal homes, bamboo houses, tents) are not treehouses.
evidence_quote: Nestled high up in the branches of two bunut trees overlooking the tropical valley, Treehouse is one of Bambu Indah’s signature accommodations
reason: Official site shows one free-standing treehouse in trees among 24 houses; remaining houses are ordinary or non-treehouse structures.
page_issues: Page never mentions the Treehouse, the only unit that fits this category
'Each structure is reclaimed Indonesian architectural history' overstated: many houses are new bamboo builds
River pools 'carved from stone' not supported by the official pages checked
